name: california-ihss-county-wages-2026
title: California IHSS Individual Provider County Wage Rates 2026
description: The 2026 hourly wage each of California's 58 counties pays an IHSS Individual Provider (an in-home caregiver funded through the Medi-Cal In-Home Supportive Services program), as approved by the California Department of Social Services. Government program wages, not private-pay prices.
